title: ETAPredictionRequest
description: Feature vector generated by backend at prediction time and sent to the ETA or ML model.

target_station_id.description: Future station for which ETA is being predicted.

observed_at.description: Time at which the prediction is generated.

current_speed_kmph.description: Current train speed at prediction time.

average_speed_last_5_minutes.description: Average train speed during the previous five minutes.

current_delay_minutes.description: Current delay relative to the scheduled running state.

distance_to_target_km.description: Remaining railway distance to the target station.

scheduled_time_to_target_minutes.description: Remaining scheduled travel time to the target station.

rainfall_mm.description: Rainfall at the relevant location and time.

historical_section_average_minutes.description: Historical average running time for the relevant railway section.
